events.title: 리버풀 suffer a shock fourth round exit from the League Cup to Third Division 피터버러 유나이티드 , who beat them 1–0 at London Road .
Peter Bosz makes his debut for the Netherlands national football team , replacing striker Wim Kieft after 85 minutes in the game against Greece .
Ossie Ardiles pays 레스터 시티 £250,000 to bring Irish international striker David Kelly to 뉴캐슬 유나이티드.
선덜랜드 pay a club record £900,000 for 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 striker Don Goodman .
첼시 sign striker Clive Allen from 맨체스터 시티 for £250,000.

Leeds retain their lead of the First Division with a 2–0 win at Luton, with 맨체스터 유나이티드 keeping up the pressure with a 4–0 home win over 코번트리 시티, who have slumped to 15th place in the table. 셰필드 웬즈데이 climb into third place with a 3–0 home win over 첼시 . 맨체스터 시티's title challenge is fading fast with a 3–1 defeat at 애스턴 빌라. 리버풀's frustrating season continues with a 1–1 draw at 사우샘프턴, restricting them to 10th place.
레드스타 Belgrade wins the Intercontinental Cup in FC 도쿄, Japan by defeating Chile's Colo-Colo 3–0. Vladimir Jugović scores twice for the Yugoslavs.

Bill Fox, president of the Football League and chairman of 블랙번 로버스, dies after a short illness at the age of 63. Former 맨체스터 유나이티드 and 아스널 striker Frank Stapleton moves into management as player-manager of Third Division side 브래드퍼드 시티 .

밀월 receive the go-ahead to relocate to a new 20,000-seat stadium at Bermondsey . Construction work is expected to begin within the next few months and chairman Reg Burr is hoping to have his team playing in their new stadium for the 1993–94 season.
리버풀 pay 아스널 £1.5million for midfielder Michael Thomas , the player whose last minute goal deprived them of the league title in 1989.

Leeds drop two points in the league when 토트넘 홋스퍼 hold them to a 1–1 draw at Elland Road . Former 에버턴 player Joe Royle hosts his former club for the first time as Oldham manager, and the newly promoted Latics hold their opponents to a 2–2 draw at Boundary Park . 블랙번 로버스 go top of the Second Division for the first time this season with a 3–0 home win over 브리스틀 로버스 .
In the only Football League action of the day, 맨체스터 유나이티드 return to the top of the First Division with a 3–1 win over 첼시 at Stamford Bridge .
리버풀 climb into fourth place in the league with a 2–1 win over 토트넘 홋스퍼 at White Hart Lane .

루턴 타운 achieve only their third league win of the season by beating Coventry 1–0 at Kenilworth Road . 사우샘프턴, second from bottom in the First Division, manage a 1–1 draw at home to 노츠 카운티, who have now fallen into the relegation zone. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드's woes continue with a 2–0 defeat at 플리머스 아가일 , who climb out of the Second Division drop zone.

Ian Wright scores all four of 아스널's goals as they beat 에버턴 4–2 in the league at Highbury . 첼시 defeat 올덤 애슬레틱 by the same scoreline at Stamford Bridge. 리버풀 and 맨체스터 시티 draw 2–2 at Anfield. QPR's upturn continues with a 1–0 at 노리치 시티 lifting them four positions into 13th place. 셰필드 웬즈데이 keep up the pressure on the top two with a 2–0 home win over 윔블던. Down in the Second Division, an exciting encounter at the Goldstone Ground sees 밀월 beat Brighton 4–3, with the home side now battling against relegation just months after being in the playoff final and on the brink of the First Division. 울버햄프턴 원더러스 are just two points above the relegation zone.

케임브리지 유나이티드 miss out on the chance to regain their surprise lead of the Second Division when they are held to a 1–1 draw at 사우스엔드 유나이티드 , who occupy an impressive fifth place in the league halfway through their first season in the Second Division.
맨체스터 시티 pay 리버풀 £900,000 for Steve McMahon .

사우스엔드 유나이티드 take over at the top of the Second Division in their first season at this level, but within hours are displaced by 블랙번 로버스. In the First Division, 맨체스터 유나이티드 defeat 올덤 애슬레틱 6–3 at Boundary Park , 리즈 유나이티드 are held 3–3 at home by 사우샘프턴, and 아스널 lose 1–0 at struggling 루턴 타운. Other exciting Boxing Day action includes a 3–1 home win for 애스턴 빌라 over 웨스트햄 유나이티드 and Coventry's 3–0 win over 셰필드 유나이티드 at Bramall Lane . In the Second Division, 왓퍼드 climb clear of the relegation zone with an impressive 4–0 win at 밀월.

The Merseyside derby ends in a 1–1 draw at Goodison Park . 루턴 타운's survival hopes are given a major boost when they beat 첼시 2–0 at Kenilworth Road. Defending champions 아스널 are now seventh in the league and 15 points behind leaders 맨체스터 유나이티드 after they lose 1–0 to 맨체스터 시티 at Maine Road . 노츠 카운티 move clear of the drop zone with a 3–0 win over 웨스트햄 유나이티드, which pushes the East Londoners into the bottom three. 블랙번 로버스 fall off the top of the Second Division with a 2–1 defeat at third place 입스위치 타운 . 포츠머스 close in on the playoff places by beating 미들즈브러 4–0 at Fratton Park . Bottom club 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 boost their survival hopes with a 3–0 home win over 선덜랜드.
맨체스터 유나이티드 remain top of the First Division with a 1–1 draw at home to their nearest rivals 리즈 유나이티드, who have now drawn four league games in a row.
Denis Smith is sacked after nearly five years at 선덜랜드. Malcolm Crosby takes over as caretaker manager.

The year draws to a close with 맨체스터 유나이티드 top of the table by two points and with two games in hand over second-placed 리즈 유나이티드. Their closest challengers, 셰필드 웬즈데이 and 맨체스터 시티, are nine points behind the leaders. The relegation zone is occupied by 사우샘프턴, 웨스트햄 유나이티드 and 루턴 타운. In the Second Division, 케임브리지 유나이티드 have restored their lead at the top, level on points with 블랙번 로버스, 입스위치 타운 and 미들즈브러. 사우스엔드 유나이티드 and 레스터 시티, just one point behind them, complete the top six.
